relations: The clock rests on rigid cracked asphalt, so any push would translate or roll it along the surface.
The puddle and damp patch can spread or shrink depending on wind, heat, or added liquid on the ground.
A loose wire trails from the clock base, so moving the clock would tug or drag it across the pavement.
The clock hands stay fixed to the casing unless the casing rotates or the hands advance with time.
